Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to incorporate the existing general knowledge about plant biology (i.e., that leaves are the primary sites of photosynthesis and collect the most sunlight) into its reasoning. Instead, it initiated repetitive cycles of targeted queries and evidence gathering, leading to task stagnation. The error could be categorized as over-prioritizing external source verification without effectively synthesizing well-established scientific knowledge. This misstep set off a lengthy chain of redundant and unnecessary queries to WebSurfer without a conclusive resolution, leading to inefficient problem-solving.
